'''Cassius tree''' was a type of [[Tree/Legends|tree]]. A [[Cassius tea/Legends|special type]] of [[Tea/Legends|tea]] was made from its florets. According to [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]], the tea that came from it was good for the health.
